## Related Issue
<!-- Link the bug report this PR fixes: #123, or "None" if fixing an unreported bug -->

## Bug Summary
<!-- Briefly: what was wrong and what behavior was expected. -->
<!-- Reference the issue for full details (error messages, stack traces, screenshots). -->

## Root Cause
<!-- What caused the bug (code path, logic error, platform-specific behavior, etc.). -->
<!-- Skip if the cause is already described in the linked issue. -->

## Fix Description
<!-- What was changed and why. Mention key files/modules touched. -->

## Affected Components
<!-- Check all that apply — same list as the Bug Report issue template -->
- [ ] UI / Widgets
- [ ] libshapes
- [ ] rsised module
- [ ] Build System (qmake)
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Environment Tested
<!-- Where the fix was verified — same format as the Bug Report issue template -->
<!-- OS (e.g., Ubuntu 22.04, Windows 11), Qt version, compiler, build type (Debug/Release) -->

## Verification
<!-- Steps confirming the bug is fixed. Ideally repeat the "Steps to Reproduce" from the issue and show they no longer trigger the bug. -->

## Logs / Output
<!-- Paste any relevant logs, console output, or before/after build output. -->

## Author Checklist
- [ ] Linked an existing issue (or explained why there is none).
- [ ] Added or updated tests covering the fix (where applicable).
- [ ] Verified on both Linux and Windows builds (or explained why not).
- [ ] No new warnings introduced by the compiler.
- [ ] Update logs attached above (if relevant).
